So far, this planet had been a blast to explore, ancient ruins all around to discover and explore to her hearts content, dodging spikes, literal fireballs, and falling debris, it’s all been one big thrill, and hey, she even discovered an entire village of kobolds, she couldn’t be any more excited, truly!*
